sources.title: GitHub - mrcahyono265/yolo26n-face
sources.snippet: YOLO26n-Face is a final year research project that I developed using the Ultralytics YOLO framework. This project aims to train a very lightweight face detection model for resource-constrained devices such as Drones (UAV). This model is the result of Transfer Learning from the official Ultralytics base model, which was then fine-tuned specifically on the WiderFace dataset to recognize faces in ...
